name: selfEmployeeTrainingApplication
description: Lets an Employee apply for a specific scheduled training for themselves. Resolves the schedule from either scheduleId or courseName, checks eligibility and surfaces any leave-date clashes for the selected schedule, then runs the real validate-then-save flow (ValidateApplyTraining -> SaveApplyTraining) with AppType 000001 and an empty NomiList (self-application does not select an employee in an outgoing list - the applicant is resolved from session identity). This is a write tool - it submits a real training application on success.
